:::{#exr-cyclone-choose-dist}
#### Choosing a distribution family

What parametric family of probability distributions might we use
to model this empirical distribution?

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-cyclone-choose-dist}
The Poisson family.
The data are counts,
which can take any non-negative integer value.
The binomial family also models counts,
but a binomial count has an upper limit (its number of trials),
and there is no natural upper limit
on the number of cyclones in a season.
:::
